about.title: About Us
about.heading: A specialist vape store for adults in Armenia
about.body: Vape Hub brings original devices, pod systems, coils and e-liquids from established brands to adult customers across Armenia. We check every batch we sell, publish honest product information and deliver to every region.
about.body2: We do not make health claims about our products. Vaping products contain nicotine, which is addictive, and are intended only for adults who already use nicotine.
about.mapTitle: Map showing the Vape Hub location in Yerevan

contact.title: Contact
contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.text: Questions about an order, a device or delivery? Send us a message and we will reply within one business day.
contact.name: Your name
contact.subject: Subject
contact.sent: Thank you — your message was received. We will reply by email.

age.q: Who can buy from Vape Hub?
age.a: Only adults aged 18 and over. We ask you to confirm your age on the website and at checkout, and the courier may ask for identification on delivery.

delivery.a: Delivery in Yerevan costs {yerevan}, delivery to other regions costs {other}. Orders from {threshold} (after discounts) ship free.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Cash on delivery is always available. Online payment with Idram or ArCa cards is shown at checkout when it is enabled.

vat.a: Yes. All prices are shown in Armenian dram and already include 20% VAT. The VAT amount is shown in your order summary.

reservation.q: Are items reserved while I pay online?
reservation.a: Yes. When you choose an online payment, the items are reserved for a limited time. If the payment is not confirmed in time, the reservation is released.

returns.a: Unopened products can be returned according to our Shipping and Returns policy. Defective devices are handled under the manufacturer's warranty.

legal.reviewNotice: Draft text — must be reviewed by a qualified Armenian legal professional before launch.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Account details (name, email, phone), delivery addresses, order history and technical data needed to keep your session secure. We do not store payment card numbers.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To process and deliver orders, provide customer support, prevent fraud and, if you subscribe, send newsletters. You can unsubscribe at any time.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: Couriers and payment providers receive only what they need to complete your order. Media is hosted with Cloudinary. We never sell personal data.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request access, correction or deletion of your personal data by contacting us. Some order records must be kept to meet legal and tax obligations.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 years old to use this shop and to receive deliveries. We may refuse or cancel orders where age cannot be confirmed.

orders.title: Orders and prices
orders.body: Prices are in AMD and include VAT. An order is confirmed when we accept it; for online payments, only after the provider confirms the payment. Stock is reserved per our reservation rules.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Delivery fees and free-delivery thresholds are shown before you place your order and calculated on our server.

liability.title: Product information
liability.body: We describe products as accurately as possible. Nicotine products are addictive; we make no health claims.

fees.title: Delivery fees
fees.body: Yerevan: {yerevan}. Other regions of Armenia: {other}. Free delivery from {threshold} after discounts.

times.title: Delivery times
times.body: Yerevan orders are usually delivered within 1–2 business days, other regions within 2–4 business days.

returns.title: Returns
returns.body: Unopened, unused products may be returned within 14 days of delivery. E-liquids and opened pods cannot be returned for hygiene reasons unless defective.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.body: Devices carry the manufacturer's warranty. Contact us with your order number to start a claim.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or was moved.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: An unexpected error occurred. You can try again or go back to the homepage.
